title: University Internship Platform
brief: Create a web-based platform for university students to find internships, upload their CV, search positions, receive AI matching suggestions, and track application status.

title: Medical Appointment System
brief: Build a healthcare appointment platform where patients book doctors, upload documents, receive reminders, and doctors manage schedules securely.

title: E-Commerce Platform
brief: Create an online store with product catalog, cart, checkout, payments, user reviews, recommendations, and admin analytics.

title: Learning Management System
brief: Develop a platform for course enrollment, lessons, quizzes, assignments, grading, and progress tracking.

title: Cybersecurity Incident Reporting Tool
brief: Build a company tool for reporting suspicious emails, triaging incidents, assigning severity, and generating audit logs.

title: AI Resume Screening Assistant
brief: Create a system for HR teams to upload job descriptions and CVs, rank candidates, explain matching reasons, and support human review.

title: Food Delivery System
brief: Create a food delivery platform with customer orders, restaurant dashboard, driver assignment, tracking, payments, and ratings.

title: Smart Parking System
brief: Design a parking reservation system where drivers find available spaces, reserve slots, pay online, and receive QR entry codes.

title: Bank Loan Portal
brief: Create a secure banking portal for loan applications, document uploads, eligibility feedback, review workflow, and approval tracking.

title: Travel Planning Assistant
brief: Build a platform for creating travel itineraries, comparing destinations, managing bookings, and storing travel documents securely.

title: Smart Home Dashboard
brief: Design a dashboard to monitor and control IoT devices, configure automation rules, receive alerts, and analyze energy usage.

title: Legal Document Review Assistant
brief: Develop a system where users upload contracts, receive summaries, identify risky clauses, ask questions, and export review notes.

title: Fitness Coaching App
brief: Create an app for fitness goals, workout tracking, personalized plans, trainer connection, and progress monitoring.

title: Real Estate Listing Platform
brief: Build a real estate platform where agents publish listings and users search properties, schedule visits, save favorites, and compare prices.

title: Customer Support Chatbot
brief: Develop a support assistant that answers FAQs, escalates issues to human agents, stores conversation history, and provides analytics.

title: Hospital Inventory System
brief: Create a hospital inventory system for medicines, equipment, stock alerts, supplier orders, expiration dates, and audit reports.

title: Research Paper Recommendation System
brief: Build a platform where researchers upload interests or papers and receive publication recommendations, reading lists, and citation trends.

title: Personal Finance Budgeting App
brief: Develop an app for income tracking, expense categories, budgets, savings goals, alerts, and monthly financial reports.

title: Student Mental Health Support App
brief: Develop a confidential platform for wellbeing check-ins, counseling appointments, emergency resources, and privacy-preserving guidance.

title: Online Event Management Platform
brief: Create a platform for event creation, ticket registration, attendee management, payment processing, reminders, and analytics.
